approval: User message of 2026-11-12 giving the Topstep 50K parameters 'pour figer la specification' after research_design.md (proposal of 2026-11-12). Candidates, thresholds and windows of research_design.md taken as proposed.
disclosure_before_freeze: No configuration of this campaign (netting, B1, B2, caps, overlays) has been simulated before this freeze.

Seen before freeze, on the OOS window 2024-01-02 -> 2026-03-19: daily std, VaR99, ES95 and worst day per sleeve, per instrument and for the book at one unit per sleeve (S02 ES95 585 USD, book ES95 799 USD); daily PnL correlations. This motivated the static risk budget, so OOS is contaminated for this layer.

Seen before freeze, on each instrument's common window including OOS and EXT: minutes of overlap and of opposite positions between sleeves, distribution of |net|, contracts saved by netting (<= 1.4 %).

Seen before freeze: the 2026-11-03 lock Topstep bootstrap on 2024-01 -> 2026-03, and a scratch lifecycle simulation of 2026-11-11 on the same window where fixed leverage beat cushion-indexed deleveraging, bigger accounts and the consistency payout path.
No statistic of this campaign was computed on the IS window 2019-05-06 -> 2023-12-31 beyond what the frozen sleeve sheets already report.

frozen_book.sleeve_stop_rule_unchanged: evaluated on each sleeve's virtual PnL, independent of the aggregation and risk layers

S01.note: native quantity 1-4 (0.5 % risk) replaced by n_s; per-contract direction, entry, stop, target and exit times kept

MBT.lot_note: Topstep MBT does not follow the 10:1 micro ratio; 1 MBT = 1 mini-equivalent lot, to be confirmed in TopstepX Risk Settings

IS_common.use: lambda search for B1, Topstep lifecycle bootstrap, sequential selection, CSCV

OOS.use: single verdict read, flagged contaminated (see disclosure)

EXT.use: descriptive only, contaminated (used to remove S04)

layer_A_aggregation.virtual_state: each sleeve keeps direction d_s in {-1,0,1}, virtual PnL and stop-rule statistics
layer_A_aggregation.net_target: N_i = sum_s n_s * d_s, then caps and overlays of layer B; only the delta to the current position is traded

fills.vote_sleeves: delta executed at the open of the next minute after the vote change, +1 tick per side
fills.S01_stop_target: resting stop or limit order at the native S01 price (stop +1 tick); quantity = N_i(after S01 exit) - N_i(current), recomputed every minute, possibly zero when a cap binds
fills.forced_exit: each sleeve at its own time; whole book flat before 16:08 America/New_York

layer_A_aggregation.costs: commission + slippage applied only to contracts actually traded at instrument level
layer_A_aggregation.expected_property: without caps or overlays, netted gross PnL equals the sum of sleeve gross PnL (self-test T1)

layer_B_risk.B0_reference: lock 20261103: one unit per sleeve, S01 native sizing, no cap

B1_static_budget.ES_s: mean of the worst 5 % daily net PnL (positive number) for 1 contract, sleeve IS, inactive days included
B1_static_budget.lambda_search: grid 1.00, 1.05, ..., 10.00; keep the largest lambda such that netted book ES95 on IS_common <= k * 2000 USD and peak simultaneous lots on IS_common <= 5; if lambda = 1 already violates, n_s = 1 for all

B2_instrument_vol.sigma_it: std of daily close-to-close log returns of instrument i over the 20 previous sessions (min 15), known before the session open
B2_instrument_vol.sigma_ref_i: median of sigma_it over the instrument IS
B2_instrument_vol.mandatory_diagnostic: IS PnL per contract of each sleeve by tercile of sigma_it

B3_limits.lots: lots = (MNQ micros + MGC micros) / 10 + MBT contracts; Combine cap 5; XFA cap from the Scaling Plan tier
B3_limits.cap_overflow: the event that would exceed a cap is reduced to the maximum allowed; open positions are not reduced

instrument_daily_stop.rule: instrument intraday PnL (realised + unrealised since session open) <= -q * ES95_i -> instrument flat until session end; sleeves continue virtually
instrument_daily_stop.ES95_i: ES95 of the instrument daily netted PnL at the retained B1 sizing, instrument IS

book_daily_stop.rule: book intraday PnL <= -Y -> all flat until session end

consistency_profit_lock.rule: Combine only: book intraday PnL >= 0.55 * current_target - 50 USD -> all flat until session end

topstep_50k_rules.source: user message of 2026-11-12 citing help.topstep.com (Scaling Plan, pricing, consistency, MBT restrictions); XFA payout path from the 2026-11-11 reading, not reconfirmed on 2026-11-12

mll.level: max end-of-session balance - 2000, capped at the starting balance

xfa.scaling_plan_effective: tier read on the previous end-of-session balance

mll.level: max end-of-session balance - 2000, capped at 0; set to 0 after a payout

payout_standard_path.eligibility: 5 winning days >= 150 USD since the last payout
payout_standard_path.request_policy: at the first eligible session end

lifecycle.on_combine_pass: activation fee, new XFA at balance 0

bootstrap.method: moving block bootstrap of sessions, pooled block lengths 3/5/10/20
bootstrap.session_unit: each sampled session keeps the minute paths of all sleeves; caps, tiers and overlays are re-applied given the account state

evaluation.primary_metric: expected net cash after 126 traded sessions = 0.90 * gross payouts - fees, Standard plan
secondary_metrics: P(at least one XFA lost to MLL)
book daily Sharpe and intraday max drawdown

sequential_selection.start: layer A + B1 k=0.40, all other options at default
keep_non_default_only_if: delta primary >= 0.10 * |primary of incumbent| and delta > 0
wins on >= 55 % of paired paths where the two values differ
P(at least one XFA lost to MLL) not higher by more than 2 points

cscv.configurations: all configurations evaluated in the sequential selection
cscv.metric: mean daily netted book PnL / ES95, Combine caps, no profit lock (proxy, the lifecycle metric is too costly for 252 splits)
cscv.fallback_configuration: layer A + B1 k=0.40, no B2, no cap beyond Topstep, no overlay

verdicts.ADOPT: retained configuration beats B0 on OOS (primary metric, same paths, single read) and P(at least one XFA lost to MLL) not higher by more than 2 points; promotion as a new versioned lock, forward monitoring
verdicts.ADOPT_AGGREGATION_ONLY: layer A passes T1-T5 but no B option survives selection or OOS; netting adopted with B0 sizing
verdicts.REJECT: self-test failure, or layer B degraded on OOS; stay on B0
verdicts.forward: in all cases read on sessions after 2026-11-03
verdicts.on_failure: HYPOTHESIS_CLOSURE.md and a failure register entry

sensitivities_not_selected: 100K account, Combine phase only (XFA 100K tiers not provided): MLL 3000, target 6000, 10 lots

self_tests.T1_netting: B0 sizing without caps: netted daily gross PnL = sum of sleeve gross PnL within 0.01 USD; netted costs <= sum of sleeve costs
self_tests.T2_S01: at one unit and alone, every native S01 trade is reproduced (prices and times)
self_tests.T3_caps: lots and instrument caps never exceeded, including a synthetic scenario where all eight sleeves enter together, in Combine and in each XFA tier
self_tests.T4_overlays: after an instrument or book stop or profit lock, position stays zero until session end and virtual states keep evolving
self_tests.T5_no_lookahead: sigma_it, ES and caps use only data before the decision; perturbing later minutes changes no decision

implementation.aggregator: src/portfolio/aggregator.py (same code for backtest and live)
implementation.runner: research/book_aggregation_risk_r1_20261112/run_study.py with subcommands selftest, estimate, is, oos, report; must verify this file against SPEC_LOCK.json and every input sha256 before running
implementation.performance_note: per (session, configuration, lot cap) minute equity paths may be cached; the profit lock is applied on the cached path since it only truncates it

prohibitions: no change to any sleeve signal, vote, threshold, exit or sizing other than the S01 native sizing replacement stated above
no candidate added or threshold changed after seeing IS results without a new versioned specification
OOS read once, after the IS selection is written to disk; never used to re-rank
EXT and OOS never used for estimation
